description:
More than just a one-bedroom apartment, Hali offers a vibrant rental community designed around wellbeing, connection and convenience in the heart of Cherrywood. This thoughtfully designed apartment features a spacious open-plan kitchen and living area, a generous double bedroom with built-in wardrobes, integrated appliances, a private balcony and energy-efficient A-rated living.

Enjoy exclusive access to:
–   The Sky Gym with panoramic mountain and sea views
–   Four complimentary wellness classes each week
–   Hali discounts with on-site fitness partner Collective Fitness
–   Six roof terraces
–   Sauna facilities
–   Social lounges and six Club Houses (available for private bookings)

Designed for modern living with:
–   Enterprise-level Virgin Media Wi-Fi
–   Dedicated work zones, focus booths and meeting spaces
–   Smart technology throughout the development
–   Resident app for bookings, updates and support
–   MyPup parcel lockers for secure 24/7 package collection

Life at Hali includes:
–   Curated resident and family events throughout the year
–   Exclusive Hali Connect resident magazine
–   Dedicated on-site Management Team
–   Access to on-site YUKÕ car-sharing vehicles

Perfectly located in South Dublin with:
–   Direct access to the Luas Green Line
–   Three nearby parks with tennis courts, sports facilities and playgrounds
–   Perfectly positioned between the mountains and the sea

Experience the Hali lifestyle for yourself. Get in touch with our Leasing Team today to book a viewing and explore our apartments, amenities and community.

Please note: Advertised rents are “from” rates and vary depending on apartment size, layout, floor level and orientation. Contact our leasing team for current availability and pricing.
